2026-08-27: Both bl targets are veneer slots, not real functions -- 0x080072f8 is 0x080072e4 + 4*5, the __call_via_r5 entry, and 0x080072f0 is 0x080072e4 + 4*3, the __call_via_r3 entry (games/gs1/asm/080072e4.s). Address 0x03000168 is the established relocated-IWRAM-fill routine (destination, size, value), already named in the sibling owners at 0x080c00c4 (games/gs1/src/unidentified/main/battle/battle_owner_47.c, 20 bytes before this one), 0x08016744, and 0x08016728, all of which pass it through the r3 slot as a bare trailing literal per the fixed_sqrt.c precedent -- exactly what the current draft's closing Func_080072f0(cursor, 0x280, 0x03ff03ff, 0x03000168) already does, and that part is not in question.

The reference's mystery early 'ldr r5, [pc, #64]' (0x03000168 loaded once, kept live across both Func_080072f8 calls with no visible r5 read afterward, per CONTRIBUTING's own catalog item 4) is that same IWRAM-fill address being called through r5 for both calls -- catalog item 4 requires this to be modeled as a genuine indirect call through a function-pointer local, since r5 is beyond r3 and this compiler never assigns an AAPCS argument past r3.

Tried three source shapes for that r5-slot call: a single named IwramFill local reused for both fill() calls; two bare inline ((IwramFill)0x03000168)(...) casts with no named local; and two independently-declared locals (fill1/fill2) each initialized to the same cast. All three produced byte-identical (worse) output: candidate grows to 96 bytes / 47 differing halfwords / 42 wrong instructions, because the compiler puts the fill-pointer pseudo in r8 rather than r5 or r6, forcing an extra mov r8,r3 / push / pop r8 relay through r3 that the reference never has -- despite only two callee-saved values (destination, fill) actually being live at once, well within r4-r7. Register choice was identical across all three phrasings, which rules out a phrasing-level fix and matches this session's already-documented local-alloc.c qty_compare tie-break dead end (catalog item 2) from a new angle: the register a live-across-a-call value lands in is not steerable by re-wording the C source. Not pursued further -- would require forcing register assignment, which CONTRIBUTING.md prohibits. Reverted to the committed 84-byte / 42-differing-halfword draft; the phantom-direct-call model for Func_080072f8 remains semantically imprecise (no source-level r5 load) but is the better-scoring and non-regressing option on hand.

This does narrow the search: a working fix, if one exists, needs to make GCC choose r5 (or r6) over r8 for a value that must survive two intervening `bl`s -- e.g. by changing what else is simultaneously live at that point in the function, not by changing how the fill pointer itself is spelled. Left unexplored given this owner's small-leaf effort budget.
